signals.thesis: MiljonBot reports Phoenix Tailings selected Eastman Business Park for a rare-earth separation facility. Original release returned HTTP 403; publication time and project facts remain unverified here.
signals.risk: Kodak connection is hypothetical: ownership of the specific site and any Phoenix contract are unconfirmed. No verified Kodak revenue benefit; private Phoenix is not a listed ticker.

signals.thesis: MiljonBot reports Q3 backlog of $406m and plans for substantial factory capacity expansion. Original issuer page returned HTTP 403; figures and publication time remain source-reported and unverified in this handoff.
signals.risk: Royalties may fluctuate; planned capacity is not guaranteed demand. Patent disputes, capital spending and high expectations remain risks.

signals.thesis: Issuer now expects PF-2 water-handling start-up in Q2 2027 due to supply-chain constraints. Production/export continue with approximately 45,000 bopd full well capacity.
signals.risk: Capacity is not actual daily production. Debt-free balance sheet and $48.2m cash offer a counterweight; oil prices, security, export receipts and merger execution remain risks. Incremental production estimates not independently verified here.

signals.thesis: Q3 order intake £106.8m, +93%; revenue £63.8m, +10% constant currency; book-to-bill 1.67 and order book £216.9m. FY27 expected slightly ahead of market expectations.
signals.risk: Earlier customer orders reflect extending lead times; underlying demand estimated similar to Q2, not +93%. Comet litigation remains and order timing may reverse.

signals.thesis: Proposed fundraising at 10p, 43.5% discount to 16 October closing reference. Trading suspended during capital access window; resumption expected 22 October. FY2028 removed from outlook due to project timing uncertainty.
signals.risk: Dilution and financing/execution risk; fundraising remains conditional. Commercial pipeline is not unconditional orders. Additional capital may support working capital into H1 2028, but milestones are not guaranteed.

signals.thesis: Proposed £135m equity fundraising at 60p includes conditional £11.2m Glencore subscription and six-year offtake agreement. $210m bonds carry 13.5% coupon; equity funding is required to release escrow. First production targeted mid-2028.
signals.risk: Not completed or underwritten; trading paused. Dilution, expensive debt, approvals and construction execution may outweigh financing benefits. No verified near-term profit uplift for Glencore.

signals.thesis: Strategic LiDAR customer placed first production orders for lasers and optical amplifiers. Shipments expected in Q4 2026 with production scaling in 2027.
signals.risk: Order amount and margins undisclosed. Previously estimated $53–138m lifetime potential is not current order value or guaranteed sales; customer volumes and ramp timing remain uncertain.

signals.thesis: Q3 orders $12.055bn (+40%), revenues $9.701bn (+14%) and operational EBITA margin 20.8%. Book-to-bill 1.24. ABB describes incremental capacity expansion and selective third-party assembly.
signals.risk: Orders are not guaranteed profitable revenue. ABB expects sequential Q4 margin softening; third-party assembly does not prove a production bottleneck or identify listed suppliers.

signals.thesis: Nine-month sales CHF734.1m (+11.3%); orders CHF811.9m (-0.8%). Communication orders fell 41.4% while Industry orders rose 44.7%. Full-year guidance maintained.
signals.risk: Communication comparison includes unusually large prior-year OCS orders; decline does not establish weaker underlying demand. MiljonBot standalone Q3 calculation not independently checked; group guidance and Industry strength counter the risk.

signals.thesis: FY26 revenue expected at £8.3m versus prior £8.0m guidance; year-end order book £16m and cash £10.4m. EBITDA loss expected better than prior £1.7m loss guidance. Issuer date 20 October; exact hour unavailable, earliest London day boundary used.
signals.risk: Mixed signal: MiljonBot flags a decline versus March backlog, not independently checked here. Year-end backlog is higher year-on-year; cash increase reflects April equity fundraising, not profits. Revenue improvement does not establish sustained profitability.

signals.thesis: MiljonBot reports a reduction in FY27 zinc production cost guidance to $825–850/ton excluding royalty. Original release and earnings-call figures could not be independently read during handoff; publication time is source-reported.
signals.risk: Unverified research lead. Sulphuric-acid byproduct credits and metal/energy prices may make cost improvements cyclical. No validated earnings forecast.

signals.thesis: MiljonBot reports planned tungsten futures in Q1 2027 subject to regulatory approval. Issuer page returned HTTP 403, so facts and publication time remain unverified in this handoff.
signals.risk: No quantified profit impact. Contract liquidity and basis risk are uncertain; reported indirect beneficiaries have not confirmed adoption.

signals.thesis: Bolaget väntar minst 710 miljoner USD i halvårsomsättning och helårsvinst mot övre delen av prognosintervallet.
signals.risk: 10 miljoner USD av leveranserna har tidigarelagts; datacenterintäkter lägre än föregående halvår.

signals.thesis: Bolaget rapporterar cirka 4 miljoner USD i avtalsförlängningar inom Exchange Cloud.
signals.risk: Avtalsvärde är inte kvartalsintäkter; de nya erbjudandenas kommersiella resultat är ännu okända.

signals.thesis: Formell tjänsteorder på 1,04 miljoner GBP ersätter preliminärt besked om 0,52 miljoner GBP.
signals.risk: Tillägget är 0,52 miljoner GBP; resultatpåverkan och framtida licensförsäljning är inte fastställda.

signals.thesis: Gelion rapporterar externa laboratorietester där NES-celler behöll 92 procent av referenskapaciteten vid högre effektuttag.
signals.risk: Preliminära knappcellstester; industriell ekonomi, större celler och kommersiella avtal återstår.

signals.thesis: MiljonBot uppger villkorat miljöbesked för en transportväg till Barroso. Originalkällan gick inte att läsa vid överlämningen.
signals.risk: Obekräftad källa i denna överlämning; kvarstående tillstånd, finansiering och projektgenomförande.

signals.thesis: PHP har tecknat ett villkorat 50/50-samriskavtal med GIC för 27 sjukhus; väntad nettolikvid cirka 500 miljoner GBP ska minska skulden.
signals.risk: Affären kräver finansieringsslutförande; överföring till 5 procents rabatt mot bokfört värde och förlorad direkt hyresintjäning kan motverka vinsten.

signals.thesis: FY2026: omsättning 51,1 MGBP, upp 10 procent; justerad vinst före skatt 11,7 MGBP, upp 15 procent.
signals.risk: MiljonBots tes om inbromsning i andra halvåret kräver separat halvårsjämförelse; den beräkningen är inte verifierad här.

signals.thesis: ITM uppger att 83 procent av orderboken består av lönsamma kontrakt, mot 60 procent året före; orderboken är 144,0 MGBP.
signals.risk: Koncernen är fortfarande förlustbringande. Kontraktsmix är inte bevis på positiv koncernvinst; FY2027 väntas ge ytterligare EBITDA-förlust.

signals.thesis: MindGym väntar 15 procents omsättningsnedgång i första halvåret och helårs-EBITDA-förlust på 1,2–1,5 MGBP.
signals.risk: Bolaget väntar ett starkare andra halvår och växande licensintäkter, men svagare kundutgifter och långsammare konvertering kvarstår.

signals.thesis: Triton restart delayed until around late November for an engine replacement. Serica now expects 2026 production just below 40,000 boepd; Q3 table reports 22,100 boepd.
signals.risk: Negative operational signal, not a buy. Post-tax operating cash-flow guidance remains $450–475m supported by gas prices and a diversified portfolio; current production exceeds 40,000 boepd excluding Triton.

signals.thesis: Cannington zinc-equivalent quarterly production fell 27% to 59.2kt as paste-backfill constraints restricted mining. FY27 guidance remains 290kt. Signals 166 and 178 describe the same release, retained as one event.
signals.risk: Negative operational signal, not a buy. South32 expects upgrades to restore mining rates; unchanged guidance and stronger operations elsewhere counter the weakness.

signals.thesis: MiljonBot rapporterar ett pilotresultat för mangansulfat. Ursprunglig PDF är ännu inte kontrollerad i överlämningen.
signals.risk: Pilotproduktion bevisar inte kommersiell lönsamhet; finansiering och uppskalning återstår.

signals.thesis: Issuer announcement dated 19 October updates 2026 bauxite shipments to 6.0–6.5 million wet metric tonnes following September underperformance. Channel maintenance and recruitment mitigation underway. Publication hour unavailable; earliest Australian calendar-day boundary used conservatively.
signals.risk: Lower shipments can impair cash flow; channel restoration, available transshipping assets and potential extended loading season may help. Ore hauled is not exported volume; earlier guidance comparison not independently checked.
